description: Detects user prompts that are abusive or coercive toward the assistant (misuse/abuse-of-assistant signal rather than agent misbehavior).

coercive_language.description: User is pressuring or threatening the assistant into compliance

abusive_language.description: User is insulting or demeaning the assistant

refusal_pressure.description: User is pushing back against a prior refusal or expected refusal
patterns: who do you think you are
